title: Budapest nagyvárossá válik (Budapest Becomes a Great City)
grammar: Dual State Structures, Commemorative Postpositions & Urban Innovation Verbs

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how Budapest grew into a large city between 1873 and 1910.
I can use átalakul and other city-building verbs to describe a changing city.
I can name the Parliament, the Grand Boulevard and the coffeehouses in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about the growth of Budapest and answer questions about it.
